name: EagleStone AI
desc: EagleStone AI is a decentralized real estate promotion group that manages complex financial consolidations across multiple European markets. The company leverages Prophix to streamline reporting, improve data transparency, and support strategic decision-making for its investors.
whoText: EagleStone AI is a decentralized real estate promotion group headquartered in Luxembourg. The company operates across Belgium, France, and Luxembourg, managing complex financial reporting and consolidation for various project-based investors.

data.label: BUSINESS CHALLENGES
data.heading: Navigating a complex, decentralized consolidation process
data.body:
Before implementing the current Prophix configuration, the group relied on a fragmented process where the French entity operated on a separate system, providing only consolidated contributions to the group. This lack of granular data forced the consolidation manager to constantly revert to local teams for basic information, making it difficult to perform deep-dive analysis or verify intercompany eliminations effectively.

The status quo was unsustainable because the group required a unified view to satisfy IFRS reporting obligations for listed shareholders. The previous setup lacked the transparency needed to handle complex real estate project structures, such as changes in consolidation methods or capital movements, ultimately causing delays in meeting critical reporting deadlines.

data.label: WHY PROPHIX
data.heading: What made Prophix the right fit
data.body:
- Requirement for a centralized system to integrate decentralized data from multiple markets.
- Need for granular visibility into local statutory figures, intercompany eliminations, and consolidation adjustments.
- Requirement for a user-friendly interface to manage complex inter-society reconciliations and reporting.

data.label: KEY RESULTS
data.heading: Achieving transparency and strategic agility
data.body:
The current state of the group’s financial consolidation is characterized by high transparency and operational efficiency. By integrating all entities directly into Prophix, the team has moved away from receiving opaque consolidated contributions, allowing for a comprehensive view of financial performance at both the local and group levels.

Collaboration has significantly improved, as the team can now perform detailed reconciliations and apply coherence controls to ensure data integrity across the board. The ability to navigate between different consolidation schemas and utilize analytical dimensions has empowered the team to provide stakeholders with precise, reliable information on demand.

Most importantly, the group has successfully transitioned from a state of constant reporting delays to consistently meeting strict deadlines. The system now enables the team to simulate complex dilution scenarios for real estate projects, providing the strategic insight required to make informed investment decisions.
